_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Turns a block repeated on several pages into one shared section, or changes where it shows; staged as a draft, dry run by default.

description: Make a block that repeats on several pages one shared section, or change where one shows. No arguments: lists blocks repeated on 3+ pages. sourceKey + selector (or selectors: a sibling run, one wrapper): a dry run finds every page with it; dryRun:false shares it. name + scope/hide/show: move an existing section to/from every page, or hide/show it per page. Over the per-call cap (too_many_pages, nothing written): share with keys, then again under the same name from a page that still has a copy; for every page then move with name + scope every_page + keys (max-1 pages a call; put all hide on the first) until all are moved. Always a draft (publish_site to go live; undo: revert_change).

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

dryRun.description: Default true: report what would change and write nothing. false: stage the change as a draft (publish_site makes it live).

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

hide.description: every_page: pages that should not show it (they keep their own copy). Send them with the first move, never later.

ifMatch.description: The page's content hash (analyze's sourceEtag). If the page changed since, nothing is written.

keepLayout.description: With selectors: wrapper gets style="display:contents" so a flex/grid parent lays the run out as before. Default true.

keys.description: Pages with an exact copy to share it on (analyze's matches.keys). Omit for every exact copy. The source page is always included.

name.description: With sourceKey + selector: the new section's name (default: proposed). Alone: the existing section to re-place.

scope.description: where_found: each page that has it gets a reference. every_page: one slot in the layout, at the top or bottom of the page content; pages listed in `hide` don't show it.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element in the page's stored HTML (the editor's selector, or one checked with get_content?selector=). It must match exactly one element.

selectors.description: Instead of selector: a run of elements next to each other in one parent, in page order (each matches one element). Shared as one section inside a wrapper, on the pages with the same run.

show.description: Pages that should show it again (removes their marker).

similar.description: Pages with a similar copy (analyze's similar.keys) that take the shared version, losing their own wording. Default none.

sourceKey.description: Content key of the page the element is on, e.g. 'about.html'.

wrapTag.description: With selectors: the wrapper. Default footer when the run ends the page content, else section.

name: share_section
